title: 第10章 涤尘丹第11章 镇压姜云芝
content_zh:
“涤尘丹！”
“上品灵丹！”
“有洗髓伐毛，脱胎换骨之功效！”
楚夏感受到丹药的信息，忍不住咽了咽口水。
灵丹啊，这可是修仙者才有本事炼製出来的丹药。
其功效绝不是培元丹之流的普通丹药可以比擬的。
这颗涤尘丹对楚夏绝对有大好处，能够让他的体质强化一大截。
没有任何犹豫，楚夏直接將涤尘丹服下。
等了一会，楚夏开始犯困，倒头就睡了过去。
……
兰溪殿。
殿內殿外上百名宫女太监，正在忙碌不休。
似乎是在准备迎接某位大人物的到来。
一名提著水桶的太监跑的太过匆忙，一不小心摔在地上，桶里的水洒了一地。
正路过的夏蓝曦，裙摆上被溅了两滴水，顿时勃然大怒。
“不长眼的狗奴才，拖下去砍了！”
两名龙渊卫顷刻出动，將那太监拖了出去。
“殿下息怒，圣子大人马上就要到了。”
一名宫女急忙跑来安抚道。
夏蓝曦抓住宫女的手，忐忑不安的说道：“小然，我有点紧张怎么办，许哲哥哥来自仙门，会不会瞧不上我们这种世俗皇族子弟。”

“殿下你就放心吧，圣子大人那么喜欢你，又岂会在意身份。”
“但愿如此吧。”
这个世界从始至终都是仙道为尊，大乾皇朝不管在世俗中拥有何等的统治力，面对正统的修仙势力，依然处於劣势。
夏蓝曦从来不在乎什么祖龙祭典，在她看来，就算当了大乾的女帝又如何，就凭大乾传承的那些修仙功法，根本不足以让她修炼成仙。
只有加入升仙门这样真正的仙家势力，她才有问鼎长生大道的机会。
那可是长生啊……
岂不比一个世俗世界的女帝要强的多。
这也是夏蓝曦在接触到许哲后，立刻毫不犹豫斩断情缘的主因。
楚夏在大乾国的確称得上少年才俊，可上限终究是太低了。
比不上许哲哥哥的万分之一。
不是我无情，而是修仙之人，必须心狠手辣，不择手段。
毕竟修仙之路就是逆天改命之路，没有逆天的觉悟，谈何修仙。
夏蓝曦努力挤出一抹甜美的笑容来。
“走吧，跟我去殿外等许哲哥哥来，我会用我的魅力將许哲哥哥牢牢抓在手里！”
话音刚落，九霄天外传来一声振聋发聵的剑鸣呼啸。
只见一道蓝色的剑影从万米高空垂直落下，顷刻间便出现在了兰溪殿外。
从飞剑之上，落下一名身著白衣，丰神俊茂，气质出尘的俊美男子。
看到飞奔出来的夏蓝曦，男子缓缓落地。
“许哲哥哥，我想死你了，你这次来一定要多留几日，让蓝曦一尽地主之谊，带你好好领略我们大乾的江山美景。”
许哲微微一笑：“恐怕要让你失望了，我这次路过大乾，是来收罗一些炼製涤尘丹的材料，只能停留半日，隨后还要去一趟万古荒原，与另外几位师弟会合。”

“啊……没关係的许哲哥哥，半日也好，让蓝曦好好招待你吧。”
说著，夏蓝曦亲昵的挽著许哲的胳膊，走进了兰溪殿中……
……
……
content_en:
"Cleaning Dust Pill!"
"High-quality elixir!"
"It has the effect of washing the marrow and cutting away the hair, reborn!"
Chu Xia felt the message of the elixir and couldn't help but swallow her saliva.
Spirit elixir, this is an elixir that only immortal cultivators are capable of refining.
Its efficacy is by no means comparable to ordinary elixirs such as Peiyuan Dan.
This Cleansing Pill is definitely of great benefit to Chu Xia, as it can greatly strengthen his physique.
Without any hesitation, Chu Xia took the Cleansing Pill directly.
After waiting for a while, Chu Xia started to feel sleepy and fell asleep.
…
Lanxi Hall.
Hundreds of palace maids and eunuchs were busy inside and outside the palace.
It seems to be preparing for the arrival of a certain big shot.
A eunuch carrying a bucket ran too hastily and accidentally fell it to the ground. The water in the bucket spilled all over the floor.
Xia Lanxi, who was passing by, got two drops of water splashed on her skirt, and she suddenly became furious.
"You blind dog slave, drag him down and chop him!"
Two Long Yuan guards immediately dispatched and dragged the eunuch out.
"Your Highness, calm down, the Holy Son will be arriving soon."
A palace maid hurriedly ran over to comfort her.
Xia Lanxi grabbed the palace maid's hand and said uneasily: "Xiao Ran, I'm a little nervous. What should I do? Brother Xu Zhe comes from the Immortal Sect. Will he look down on secular royal children like us?"
"Your Highness, don't worry. The Holy Son likes you so much, so why would he care about your identity?"
"I hope so."
This world has always been dominated by immortality. No matter how dominant it is in the world, the Daqian Dynasty is still at a disadvantage when facing the orthodox immortal forces.
Xia Lanxi never cared about the Ancestral Dragon Festival. In her opinion, even if she became the empress of Daqian, the immortal cultivation techniques inherited by Daqian would not be enough for her to become an immortal.
Only by joining a real immortal force like the Shengxian Sect can she have a chance to aspire to the road to immortality.
That's immortality...
Isn't she much stronger than an empress in the secular world?
This is also the main reason why Xia Lanxi immediately broke off the relationship without hesitation after coming into contact with Xu Zhe.
Chu Xia is indeed a young talent in Daqian Kingdom, but the upper limit is too low after all.
Not as good as one ten thousandth of brother Xu Zhe.
It’s not that I’m heartless, but those who cultivate immortality must be ruthless and use any means necessary.
After all, the road to becoming an immortal is to go against the will of heaven and change one's destiny. Without the enlightenment to go against the will of heaven, there is no way to become an immortal.
Xia Lanxi tried her best to smile sweetly.
"Let's go, follow me outside the palace and wait for Brother Xu Zhe to come. I will use my charm to hold Brother Xu Zhe firmly in my hand!"
As soon as he finished speaking, a deafening roar of swords came from outside the sky.
I saw a blue sword shadow falling vertically from a height of 10,000 meters, and appeared outside Lanxi Hall in an instant.
From the flying sword, a handsome man in white clothes, handsome and handsome, with an extraordinary temperament fell down.
Seeing Xia Lanxi running out, the man slowly landed.
"Brother Xu Zhe, I miss you so much. You must stay a few more days this time so that Lan Xi can fulfill his friendship as a landlord and take you to appreciate the beautiful scenery of our country."
Xu Zhe smiled slightly: "I'm afraid I'm going to disappoint you. I passed by Daqian this time to collect some materials for refining the Cleansing Pill. I can only stay for half a day, and then I have to go to the Eternal Wasteland to meet up with several other junior brothers."
"Ah...it doesn't matter, brother Xu Zhe, half a day is fine, let Lan Xi entertain you."
With that said, Xia Lanxi took Xu Zhe's arm affectionately and walked into Lanxi Palace...
…
